name: Jesberg (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of yellow with green edges each enclosing a narrow white stripe, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Jesberg (yellow oak leaves and a castle on green).
history: The flag was approved by the Hessian Ministry of the Interior on 3 November 1988; it is divided lengthwise green-white-green-yellow-green-white-green (4.5:1:4.5:32:4.5:1:4.5) with the arms on the yellow.

features.role: Jesberg arms — oak leaves and castle on green
